parameters.label: Tensor parallel size
parameters.description: Split each layer across this many devices (GPUs, or CPU NUMA nodes on the CPU build).
parameters.name: --tensor-parallel-size

parameters.label: Pipeline parallel size
parameters.description: Split the layer stack into this many sequential stages.
parameters.name: --pipeline-parallel-size

parameters.label: Concurrent sequences
parameters.description: Most requests the server batches at once.
parameters.name: --max-num-seqs

parameters.label: Context length
parameters.description: Longest prompt plus completion the server accepts, in tokens.
parameters.name: --max-model-len
parameters.default_behavior: Fit to GPU: the model's maximum, capped to fit the GPU

strategies.label: Fit to GPU
strategies.description: The largest context up to the model's own maximum whose KV cache fits the deployment's GPU memory beside the weights, with headroom.

context_sizing.fit_to_gpu_reason: Fit to GPU reads the model and GPU on Linux hosts only

parameters.label: GPU memory fraction
parameters.description: Share of each GPU's memory vLLM may reserve (0.05 to 1).
parameters.name: --gpu-memory-utilization

parameters.label: KV cache memory (GiB)
parameters.description: Host memory reserved for the key-value cache on the CPU build.
parameters.name: VLLM_CPU_KVCACHE_SPACE

parameters.label: Intel GPU devices
parameters.description: Level Zero devices the server may use, such as 0,1 (in FLAT mode each GPU tile is one device). Match the count to the tensor parallel size.
parameters.name: ZE_AFFINITY_MASK

parameters.label: CPU cores
parameters.description: Cores the CPU build pins its threads to, such as 0-15, or auto.
parameters.name: VLLM_CPU_OMP_THREADS_BIND

parameters.label: Tool-call parser
parameters.description: Turns on tool calling with the parser for this model family (Qwen2.5 and Hermes-style templates use hermes). Without it vLLM refuses tool calls.
parameters.name: --tool-call-parser
parameters.default_behavior: Chosen from the model family (off when the family is unknown)

parameters.label: Reasoning parser
parameters.description: Separates the model's thinking from its answer and returns it as reasoning_content (Qwen3 uses qwen3). Without it a thinking model's <think> text arrives inside the answer.
parameters.name: --reasoning-parser
parameters.default_behavior: Chosen from the model family (thinking left inside the answer when unknown)

parameters.label: Weight precision
parameters.description: Data type for weights and activations.
parameters.name: --dtype
